headline_options: Limited beta: member-list CSV export for selected Team workspaces
Team workspace owners can try member-list CSV export in limited beta
confirmed_change: Workspace owners in selected Team-plan workspaces can export a member list as CSV.
audience_impact: The documented change applies to workspace owners on the Team plan whose workspaces have beta access.
limitation: Exports contain only names and email addresses, and access is limited to selected workspaces.

fact_trace.statement: Workspace owners can export a member list as CSV.
Access is limited to selected Team workspaces.
